summary: NDR feed s058_single is degraded due to 5.2% packet loss (147 of 2843 TCP packets, threshold 1%) indicating visibility fabric drops; all other checks (duplicates, one-way, VLANs, encryption, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: SPAN/mirror or packet broker is oversubscribed and dropping packets under load - 5.2% TCP sequence gaps indicate buffer exhaustion before the NDR. Tool overload check is healthy, so loss is in the TAP/SPAN/broker path, not at the tool itself.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires complete bidirectional full-payload traffic for TCP reassembly and detection. Missing packets break stream reconstruction, cause incomplete flows, missed detections and significantly reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: SPAN/mirror ports drop packets when oversubscribed; replacing with passive TAP (with properly sized packet broker/aggregation) provides lossless line-rate copy and eliminates the 5%+ loss before the NDR.
